SELECT bdrg_sn, plat_plc, sgg_cd_nm, stdg_cd_nm, siar, bdar, bdcvrt, gfa, fart, strct_cd_nm, mn_usg_cd_nm, grnd_nofl, udgd_nofl, hh_cnt, use_aprv_ymd FROM building
ORDER BY bdrg_sn LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.bdrg_sn, b.plat_plc, b.sgg_cd_nm, b.stdg_cd_nm, b.siar, b.bdar, b.bdcvrt, b.gfa, b.fart, b.strct_cd_nm, b.mn_usg_cd_nm, b.grnd_nofl, b.udgd_nofl, b.hh_cnt, b.use_aprv_ymd, g.centroid_lat AS lat, g.centroid_lng AS lng FROM building b LEFT JOIN building_gis_mapping bgm ON bgm.building_id = b.bdrg_sn LEFT JOIN gis_building g ON g.id = bgm.gis_building_id
ORDER BY b.bdrg_sn LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ir.grade AS grade, COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(ir.roi) AS avgRoi FROM building b JOIN investment_result ir ON ir.building_id = b.bdrg_sn AND ir.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY ir.grade
